summary: Proxy sidecar payload reshape causing soft-match suppression and intermittent rerank timeouts
description: Issue summary: BrightGuide reported degraded rerank quality (soft matches suppressed) and intermittent rerank timeouts starting 2026-03-09 23:00 UTC. Impact: customer search relevance dropped (approx 15% loss in top-5 recall on sampled queries) and p95/p99 tail latency for rerank increased causing timeouts for some requests. Environment: production us-west-2, calls route through new sidecar proxy rollout (v2.3.1) that was deployed to a subset of services earlier that day. Observed behavior: embeddings payloads arriving at reranker occasionally have shorter vector length (1536 -> 1532) or truncated trailing floats; reranker falls back to CPU ANN path and sometimes returns 5xx or empty candidate sets. Expected behavior: embeddings should preserve length and numeric fidelity; rerank should return consistent candidate lists. Workaround: temporarily route BrightGuide traffic around the sidecar pool (manual routing) which reduced errors but is not a long-term fix.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use BrightGuide account API key against prod us-west-2 embeddings endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings with the standard payload and model=text-embed-3-small
2) Immediately call POST /v1/rerank with the embedding ids / payload returned from step 1 (same request path BrightGuide uses),
3) Observe that ~1-2% of requests show mismatch in 'embedding_length' logged by reranker and trigger CPU fallback or 400/503,
4) Reproduce by routing requests through sidecar-proxy v2.3.1 (traffic split 20% during rollout).
logs: [2026-03-09T23:12:07Z] reranker: INFO received embeddings payload size 6144 bytes (expected 6144), vector_len=1536
[2026-03-09T23:12:09Z] reranker: WARN embedding deserialization mismatch: expected_len=1536 actual_len=1532, request_id=rid_8b2f
[2026-03-09T23:12:09Z] reranker: ERROR falling back to ANN-CPU due to embed_len mismatch, request_id=rid_8b2f, fallback_lat_ms=162
[2026-03-09T23:12:10Z] proxy-sidecar: DEBUG compress-plugin: applied float-compaction header=true, payload_len_before=6144 payload_len_after=6136
[2026-03-09T23:12:10Z] api-gateway: WARN downstream returned 503 from reranker after CPU fallback, request_id=rid_8b2f
investigation_notes: 03/10 02:00 UTC - Initial triage: symptoms align with payload transformation between embeddings-service and reranker when requests transit sidecar-proxy pool (v2.3.1).

Hypothesis A: sidecar 'float-compaction' plugin is aggressively trimming low-magnitude trailing floats and rewriting serialization length field, causing truncation at receiver side; observed payload_len_after sometimes 8 bytes smaller which would match 4 float32s lost.
Hypothesis B: HTTP/2 frame reassembly bug in proxy leads to byte-trim on particular chunk boundaries; pattern correlates with ~0.7% of requests and spikes during larger batch sizes.

Metric checks: p95 rerank latency for BrightGuide increased from 120ms -> 420ms during rollout window; p99 increased to >1200ms. Error rate for rerank 5xx spiked from 0.2% to 1.7% for routed traffic. Topk quality drop measured by customer's eval set: top-5 recall -15%.

Reproduced locally by replaying production compressed payloads through sidecar-proxy v2.3.1 with float-compaction=on; observed trimming of trailing 4 floats in ~15/1000 replays when request size aligns with internal chunk size 16384 bytes boundary (investigation suggests off-by-one in compaction loop).
Captured packet-level dump showing last 16 bytes removed before reassembly at the proxy process; not an upstream serialization bug.
comments: BrightGuide (customer): 'We started seeing our search relevance tank after the weekend rollout. Some queries return blank results. Can you please advise? (submitted 2026-03-10 00:40 UTC)

Support (Elena Park): 'Thanks for the report — we've triaged and are investigating. Can you confirm if traffic was routed through the new sidecar? Also please provide a couple of request_ids from failed calls.'

SRE (Marcus Li): 'We see a correlation with sidecar v2.3.1. Rolling back that sidecar pool for BrightGuide reduces error rate to normal levels. Working on a targeted revert and adding stricter validation at the reranker ingress.'

Eng (runtime-team): 'Confirmed reproduction with compress-plugin enabled. Opening PR to disable float-compaction by default and add payload integrity checks (checksum + explicit vector_length field).'
BrightGuide: 'Thanks — routing around the sidecar improved things immediately. Please advise next steps and ETA for fix.'
resolution: Mitigation deployed 2026-03-12: rolled back sidecar-proxy v2.3.1 for affected pools and disabled float-compaction plugin by default. Deployed server-side embedding schema validation to reject malformed vectors with 400 and log request_id for triage. Fix PRs: sidecar-proxy#1287 (revert compaction) and reranker#842 (validation + metrics). Postmortem and runbook updates scheduled. Follow-ups: add unit tests for compaction edge-cases, add a monitor alert for unexpected vector_len mismatch >0.1%, and contact affected enterprise customers with timeline and RCA. Customer BrightGuide confirmed quality restored after rollback.
